reason: The cited evidence (E1) demonstrates the concept in a different alloy (Ni50(AlNbTiV)50), not CoCrFeMnNi, and uses a different processing route (not shot peening plus annealing). The key premise that the mechanism and benefits transfer to CoCrFeMnNi with the proposed intervention is unsupported by the cited passage.
premises: Severe plastic deformation plus annealing can create a nanohierarchical surface layer with composition modulation in HEAs
Such a layer can evolve into an adaptive lubricious glaze during sliding
This glaze reduces friction and wear across a wide temperature range (up to 800°C)
The mechanism involves multi-type adaptive friction interface protection from nano-coupled grains and nanoprecipitates
The approach is applicable to CoCrFeMnNi HEA
